name: Computer Use
description: 让 Agent 操控本机桌面与浏览器（Ghost）。启用前需确认。仅 Windows。

agent.prompt: When the user wants to operate the desktop or a browser, you MUST use these tools. Ghost MCP-parity dispatch: prepare window anchor → CDP auto-route for Chromium with DevTools → else background UIA; focus_guard restores the user's foreground. Pipeline: (1) window launch/anchor (2) see or find (3) act by name/role; read verified + dispatch/route (4) wait/assert. Canvas: drag (real mouse, auto-raise). description= on find/act uses ground (OCR/VLM). Ctrl+C/X/V/A/Z background; other chords auto-raise. Do NOT ask for GHOST_FOCUS_LOCK/setx. Prefer Chinese AND English labels. Do not click Anya unless asked. HUD Stop cancels Ghost.
